requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: All ambiguities resolved via domain context and glossary. The requirement describes a functional capability of routing switches to filter specific traffic types. Structured as a single functional requirement using the supported interpretation that the switch filters traffic traversing the boundary between data-plane and management interfaces.

source_fragments: Routing switches ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic

fields.condition: when traffic traverses the boundary between data-plane and management interfaces

structured_requirements.final_statement: The routing switches shall filter network traffic that traverses the boundary between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic (SNMP traffic on UDP port 161).
structuring_notes: Resolved lexical ambiguity: 'Routing switches' refers to the hardware devices, not the action of switching.
Resolved syntactic ambiguity: 'between' implies filtering traffic crossing the boundary, not just a relationship between entities.
Resolved semantic ambiguity: Filtering applies to traffic inspecting protocol/port (SNMP) crossing the data-plane/management boundary.
Applied glossary definitions: 'management data traffic' = SNMP/UDP 161; 'filter' = inspect/drop based on protocol/port.
